description: An additive oscillator of up to 256 partials with a comb filter over its spectrum, free of aliasing at any pitch

params.text: Sets the pitch, -14 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 0.016Hz to 4186Hz
Sets the frequency above which partials are left out, as a power of two around middle C, up to about 20000Hz
Sets how quickly the partials fall away towards the top, 0.1 to 3
Tilts the sound between odd and even partials, -1 to 1; at 0 both are heard, at -1 the odd ones alone and at 1 the even ones alone
Sets which partial the sound starts from, 0 to 128, so the fundamental and the partials below it are left out
Stretches the spacing of the partials, -1.25 to 1.25; away from 0 they stop being whole multiples and the sound turns metallic
Attenuates the voltage at the Decay jack before it is added to the Decay knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Odd/Even jack before it is added to the Odd/Even knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Stretch jack before it is added to the Stretch knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets the level of the whole sound, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Amp jack before it is added to the Amp knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Slides the comb along the spectrum, 0 to one whole turn
Sets how many peaks the comb has across the partials, 1 to 100
Sets how deep the comb cuts into the spectrum, 0 to 1; at 0 the comb is off
Sets how many partials are added, 1 to 256
Attenuates the voltage at the Comb Phs jack before it is added to the Comb Phs knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Comb Freq jack before it is added to the Comb Freq knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Comb Amt jack before it is added to the Comb Amp knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Bends the comb so that its peaks are no longer evenly spaced, 0.2 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Comb Warp jack before it is added to the Comb Warp knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sharpens the peaks of the comb, 0.1 to 4; at 1 they are plain, higher settings narrow them and lower ones broaden them
Attenuates the voltage at the Comb Peek Input jack before it is added to the Comb Peek knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how far the FM jack moves the frequency, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation
Sets the level of the fundamental on its own, 0 to 1, whatever the partials above it are doing
Puts the phase of every partial back to the start

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates that fall-off, one per volt scaled by the Decay CV knob
Modulates that tilt, a tenth per volt scaled by the Odd/Even CV knob
Modulates that stretching, a tenth per volt scaled by the Stretch CV knob
Sets that first partial by cable, 12.8 partials per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Modulates the level, scaled by the Amp CV knob
Sets that number by cable, 25.6 partials per volt, and moves the knob while it is patched
Modulates the comb depth, a tenth per volt scaled by the Comb Amp CV knob
Modulates that sharpening, half a step per volt scaled by the Comb Peek CV knob
Modulates that spacing, ten per volt scaled by the Comb Freq CV knob
Modulates that bending, a tenth per volt scaled by the Comb Warp CV knob
Modulates that sliding, one per volt scaled by the Comb Phs CV knob
Modulates the frequency through the FM Amt knob

outputs.text: The wave, -5V to 5V at full level

notes: the comb controls shape the strengths of the partials rather than filtering the sound afterwards, so the comb is free of the ringing a real filter would add
menu: buffer size — sets how many samples the background thread works on at a time; a larger buffer glitches less and delays more
use thread — works the partials out on a background thread, which keeps them off the audio thread at the cost of some delay
